code:
cd ~/cs357-work
mkdir -p .devcontainer
cd .devcontainer
curl -fsSL -o Dockerfile https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BillJr99/Ursinus-CS357-Fall2026/gh-pages/files/devcontainer/Dockerfile
curl -fsSL -o docker-compose.yml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BillJr99/Ursinus-CS357-Fall2026/gh-pages/files/devcontainer/docker-compose.yml
curl -fsSL -o devcontainer.json https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BillJr99/Ursinus-CS357-Fall2026/gh-pages/files/devcontainer/devcontainer.json
cd ..
ls -la .devcontainer
description: Download the three devcontainer files from the course repository into the .devcontainer folder of your clone.

steps.description: Eight commands to set up devcontainer files.
Navigation: cd to cs357-work, then mkdir -p .devcontainer to create the folder.
Downloads: three curl commands fetch Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, and devcontainer.json from the course gh-pages.
Verification: cd back to clone root, then ls -la .devcontainer to list the three files.
